angles: Benchmark showdown: Cursor 3's 78.2% SWE-bench vs Antigravity's 76.2% — closer than expected, with Antigravity leading on refactoring accuracy (94% vs 78%) and large codebase speed (40% faster)

Architectural philosophy clash: Cursor's Agents Window with up to 8 parallel agents vs Antigravity's Manager View with 5 agents and 2M token context — which paradigm better serves real developer workflows?
Pricing disruption: Antigravity's free tier with Claude Opus 4.6 access vs Cursor's $20-40/month with credit overages — can free ever beat paid on reliability and support?
Ecosystem battle: Cursor's mature MCP marketplace with 50+ integrations vs Antigravity's Google ecosystem advantage and AgentKit 2.0 — ecosystem depth vs platform-native tools
Enterprise readiness gap: Cursor with half of Fortune 500 adopted, enterprise compliance features, and $2B ARR vs Antigravity still in rapid-growth phase with security sandbox concerns
The X-factor: Antigravity's built-in browser for frontend testing and 2M context window vs Cursor's Cloud Agents with Computer Use and Design Mode — which unique features tip the scales?
Adoption trajectory: Cursor's 1M+ DAU established dominance vs Antigravity's 6% adoption in 2 months — the fastest initial growth of any AI IDE ever
The 'paperweight' factor: Antigravity's free preview pricing controversy and 97% quota cuts vs Cursor's transparent but expensive pricing — trust and transparency as competitive advantages
Performance paradox: Antigravity builds faster (40% on large codebases) but Cursor scores higher on coding benchmarks (78.2% vs 76.2%) — speed versus accuracy tradeoff for different use cases
